text: Char, a bullied teenager at a Catholic girls' school, lives with her depressed mother Angela and her ailing grandmother Rita in a house with no food. One morning Angela says she cannot do this anymore, and [her car is found abandoned|trigger|someone goes missing]. Within days she is back, cheerful, cooking, dressing up, and [not quite herself|threat|impostors and doubles]. Rita, who once [set her baby granddaughter in a ring of fire in the woods|images|fire, smoke and burning], knows [the old way to bring the true one home|rules|it can be undone].
